messages:
Rae (CS): quick capture from today's pilot review with Solstice — three asks that could affect renewal if we don't address. dropping raw notes.
Omar (CSM): tl;dr: finance wants campaign-level cost splits, ops hit duplicate downstream writes due to retries, product wants clearer per-route latency slices. risk = medium.
Rae (CS): customer asks (verbatim):
- tag requests with campaign id for billing reconciliation
- optional server-side webhook retry with idempotency header + dead-letter option
- p50/p95 latency by route in console or CSV export
Rae (CS): they sent a curl snippet they used when duplicates happened: `curl -X POST https://hooks.solstice.io/ingest -H "X-Campaign: sol-q4" -H "X-Idempotency: aaa-111" -d '{"route":"score","uid":9001}'`
Julian (PM): good signals. which of these can we ship fastest to reduce churn risk?
Priya (Eng): fastest = header passthrough + include campaign column in usage export (~1 sprint). per-route percentiles can use existing metrics pipeline (~1 sprint). server-side retry + idempotency + DLQ is heavier (routing + DLQ design) ~2-3 sprints.
Omar (CSM): customer priority = cost export first (CFO), then retry safeguards (ops), then metrics (product). if we promise a campaign export CSV quickly, that should calm finance.
Rae (CS): action: I'll file a feature ticket with acceptance criteria and attach sample CSV rows. will confirm header name with customer (they prefer `X-Campaign`).
notif-bot: created ticket RW-9001 "campaign-tag export MVP" assigned to Product: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RW-9001 :white_check_mark:
Priya (Eng): I'll add a short tech note in RW-9001 describing header passthrough and CSV mapping. will draft idempotency/DLQ constraints in RW-9002.
Julian (PM): Priya 94 please post idempotency constraints + rough effort estimate by Thu so we can scope retries work.
Omar (CSM): I'll set customer expectation: campaign export this sprint, retry scope to follow. Rae please ping when ticket has sample CSV for CFO review.
Rae (CS): will do. closing loop for now
